description: This file defines a PHP trait named NormalizerServiceTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a method to retrieve an instance of NormalizerService from a dependency injection container, leveraging another trait for container access.

methods.name: getNormalizerService
methods.description: Returns an instance of NormalizerService by accessing the dependency injection container via the getContainer() method provided by the ServiceContainerTrait.
